photoview.n: No AVX/CPU requirement or support claim in README or Dockerfile; Dockerfile strips -march=native from go-face

lychee.n: No AVX requirement in core (PHP/FrankenPHP); sidecar CPU requirements not documented

piwigo.n: PHP application; no CPU-specific ML code in core

pigallery2.n: No AVX or CPU requirement stated in src/docs; native deps sharp 0.34.2 and ffmpeg-static 5.3.0 not verified

photofield.n: No AVX or CPU requirement stated; photofield-ai README silent on AVX; ONNX Runtime CPU requirement not verified

photonix.n: TensorFlow 2.21 is a hard dep; official TF x86 wheels use AVX (since 1.6); 2.21 not explicitly confirmed

damselfly.n: ONNX/FaceONNX ML; no CPU floor documented; ORT x64 prebuilts reportedly need AVX2 (third-party), .NET package unverified

photostructure.n: README says 64-bit Intel/AMD; tools/ also ships arm64 binaries

orchard_photos.n: Searched requirements, docs and ORT wheel info; no AVX or CPU minimum stated; ORT wheels unverified

digikam.n: No AVX need found, but SSE4.1 crashes on pre-SSE4.1 CPUs (Athlon II, bug 465548)

synology_photos.n: Face/object recognition gated by NAS model list; no published AVX or CPU instruction requirement found

google_photos.n: Hosted service
